TWI851990B.abstract: 本發明提供了一種槽式太陽能電池模組及其製備方法。其中，該槽式太陽能電池模組的基板係具有線槽的下沉結構，可以作為下導線的電極埋設於基板之中。據此，本發明之槽式太陽能電池模組可以將其光能轉換結構層和上導線直接以整面結構進行製作，大幅增加了槽式太陽能電池模組的能量轉換效率及空間。

TWI816357B.abstract: 本發明提供了一種太陽能電池模組及其製備方法。所述太陽能電池模組透過第一母線與複數個下導線的組合和第二母線與複數個上導線的組合相互配合形成一指叉狀電極結構，並將複數個光能轉換結構設置於該指叉狀電極結構之中，使該太陽能電池模組形成並聯結構。據此，形成一種發電特性穩定且可避免使用昂貴雷射設備的太陽能電池模組。

TWM612985U.abstract: This creation proposes a scaffold with adjustable illuminance, which includes a roof, a supporting structure, a rotating shaft and multiple reflectors. The canopy is provided with a plurality of light-transmitting elements, and the supporting structure supports the canopy so that the canopy is separated from the ground by a height. The rotating shaft is arranged between the roof and the ground, and the two ends are respectively fixed on the supporting structure. A plurality of reflecting plates are arranged on the rotating shaft body and can rotate relative to the rotating shaft body. By adjusting the rotation angle of the reflector to reflect sunlight, it is possible to control the illuminance of sunlight incident from the roof to the ground, thereby controlling the amount of sunlight for crops located on the ground and adjusting the temperature in the shelf.

US8470150B2.abstract: Methods for fabricating electrode structures on a substrate are presented. The fabrication method includes providing a substrate with a patterned metal layer thereon, defining an electrode area. A passivation glue is formed on the patterned metal layer. An electrode layer is formed in the electrode area. A filling process is performed to deposit nano metal oxides on the electrode layer to extensively fill the entire electrode area.

US20180062002A1.abstract: A solar cell includes a semiconductor substrate, one or more bus bar electrode, and a plurality of finger electrodes. The bus bar electrode and the finger electrodes are disposed on the semiconductor substrate. Conventionally, in a process of forming the finger electrodes by utilizing screen printing, offset may occur. Consequently, the finger electrodes cannot be connected to the bus bar electrode. According to the provided solar cell, the bus bar electrode is formed by using patterned silver and aluminum, to manufacture a wider bus bar electrode than the bus bar electrode in the conventional solar cell without increasing silver consumption, thereby resolving the problem of offset.

CN102456480A.abstract: The invention discloses a solar cell structure which comprises a conductive substrate, a light-transmitting conductive substrate, an accommodating space, a working electrode layer and a light guide channel layer, wherein the accommodating space filled with electrolyte is formed between the conductive substrate and the light-transmitting conductive substrate. The working electrode layer is positioned in the accommodating space and is arranged on the bearing surface of the conductive substrate. The light guide channel layer is arranged between the working electrode layer and the light-transmitting conductive substrate and is used as a traveling channel of light rays transmitted by the light-transmitting conductive substrate, so that the light rays reach the working electrode layer to generate working current. The solar cell structure of the invention avoids the problem of low photoelectric conversion efficiency caused by the fact that part of light is absorbed by electrolyte first. In addition, the light guide channel layer can also prevent the working electrode layer and the counter electrode of the light-transmitting conductive substrate from being contacted carelessly, so that the light guide channel layer also has the effect of preventing the battery from being short-circuited.

CN102456482B.abstract: The present invention provides a method for manufacturing a substrate electrode structure. The method comprises providing a substrate having a patterned metal layer defining an electrode region, wherein a protective glue covers the patterned metal layer, and an electrode layer is formed in the electrode region. A filling step is performed to deposit a nano-oxide on the electrode layer to fill the entire electrode region.

CN206236681U.abstract: A solar cell comprises a semiconductor substrate and at least one bus electrode and a plurality of finger electrodes disposed on the semiconductor substrate. In the conventional process of forming the finger electrodes by screen printing, misalignment may occur, so that the finger electrodes cannot be connected to the bus electrodes. The utility model forms the bus electrodes by using patterned silver and aluminum, and produces a bus electrode wider than the bus electrode of a conventional solar cell without increasing the amount of silver, thereby solving the above-mentioned misalignment problem.

CN207367985U.abstract: The utility model proposes a double-sided solar cell and a solar cell module composed of the same. The double-sided solar cell includes a solar cell substrate, a bus electrode, a plurality of first finger electrodes, a plurality of second finger electrodes and a plurality of conductive pads. The bus electrode is disposed on the first surface of the solar cell substrate and extends along the first direction, and the bus electrode is adjacent to the first side of the solar cell substrate. A plurality of first finger electrodes are disposed on the first surface of the solar cell substrate and extend along a second direction different from the first direction. One end of each first finger electrode is connected to the bus electrode. A plurality of second finger electrodes are disposed on the second surface of the solar cell substrate and extend along the second direction. A plurality of conductive pads are disposed on the second surface of the solar cell substrate and are spaced apart along the first direction. Each conductive pad is connected to one end of at least one second finger electrode, and each conductive pad is adjacent to the second side of the solar cell substrate.

TWI407579B.abstract: Methods for fabricating electrode structures on a substrate are presented. The fabrication method includes providing a substrate with a patterned metal layer thereon, defining an electrode area. A passivation glue is formed on the patterned metal layer. An electrode layer is formed in the electrode area. A filling process is performed to deposit nano metal oxides on the electrode layer to extensively fill the entire electrode area.

TWM611184U.abstract: This creation proposes a solar cell module suitable for the roof of a farm shed, which includes an outer frame, a plurality of solar cell units, and at least one light-transmitting plate. An inner area surrounded by the outer frame includes a solar cell configuration area and a battery-free area. The ratio of the area ratio between the solar cell configuration area and the battery-free area is in the range of 0.6 to 2.0. The plurality of solar battery cells are arranged in the solar battery arrangement area of the inner area of the outer frame, and the light-transmitting plate is arranged in the battery-free area. The roof of the farm shed laid by the solar cell module of this creation can allow a large amount of sunlight to penetrate, increase the illuminance inside the farm, and reduce the solar power required for the farm during the day.
